'Enable Focus Mode', 'Hide Bars' and 'All Commands…' start at x≈1746 (display px), while 'Sentence', 'Typewriter', 'Dark Mode' and 'Statistics' start at x≈1761. states.verdict: Both View menus use the same face, the same ~26 px row pitch and the same accent-blue selected row, so the difference is in how cleanly they're set. A keeps one clean left edge and hangs its ticks in a gutter, but its ticks are too bold and pull the eye away from the words. A's fault is weight and B's is alignment, and a misaligned edge is the worse fault.
